schema._description: Recon crawl of a web app, structured for AI extraction. All lists are deduplicated.
schema.target: the seed URL and hosts that were in scope
schema.endpoints: unique API/page endpoints as METHOD + path, with query params seen; the primary attack surface
schema.forms: HTML forms with their field names (input points)
schema.params: all URL parameter names seen anywhere
schema.js_endpoints: paths found INSIDE javascript, not linked on pages (often hidden/admin/internal)
schema.js_secrets: heuristic secret matches in JS - verify, many are false positives
schema.storage: localStorage/sessionStorage keys per page - may hold tokens/config
